reason: I have run our firm on spreadsheets and WhatsApp for ten years for zero rupees, so paying ₹12,990 upfront makes no sense when our current workflow costs nothing. While article clerks taking client files home on their personal laptops gives me serious anxiety, I would only ever try the free pilot to see if it truly blocks downloads before paying a single rupee.
objection: Why pay for software when Excel and WhatsApp are completely free, and will introducing a new platform just create extra friction for my 3 to 5 staff?
would_change_my_mind: Verifying on the free pilot that the Trainee Laptop Shield completely stops article clerks from saving client data to personal laptops while keeping the daily workflow dead simple.
